title: Exponentially weighted ratio comparison on [s, t] (integrating-factor step)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, c, K, s, t ∈ ℝ with c ≥ 0 and 0 < s < t, and let I, I', G, G', J, h : ℝ → ℝ. Assume that for every τ ∈ [s, t]: (D1) I has derivative I'(τ) at τ; (D2) G has derivative G'(τ) at τ; (E) n·I(τ) − τ·I'(τ) + τ·J(τ) = −h(τ); (H) |h(τ)| ≤ c·τ·I(τ); (J) J(τ) ≥ 0; (C1) G'(τ) ≤ J(τ)/τⁿ; (C2) J(τ)/τⁿ ≤ K·G'(τ). Then (a) G(t) − G(s) ≤ e^{ct}t^{−n}I(t) − e^{cs}s^{−n}I(s), and (b) e^{−ct}t^{−n}I(t) − e^{−cs}s^{−n}I(s) ≤ K·(G(t) − G(s)). In Lean, e^{bσ}σ^{−n}I(σ) is written Real.exp (b * σ) / σ ^ n * I σ, and e^{−cσ} is Real.exp (-(c * σ)).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (c K s t : ℝ) (I I' G G' J h : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ c → 0 < s → s < t → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, HasDerivAt I (I' τ) τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, HasDerivAt G (G' τ) τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, (n : ℝ) * I τ - τ * I' τ + τ * J τ = -h τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, |h τ| ≤ c * τ * I τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, 0 ≤ J τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, G' τ ≤ J τ / τ ^ n) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, J τ / τ ^ n ≤ K * G' τ) → G t - G s ≤ Real.exp (c * t) / t ^ n * I t - Real.exp (c * s) / s ^ n * I s ∧ Real.exp (-(c * t)) / t ^ n * I t - Real.exp (-(c * s)) / s ^ n * I s ≤ K * (G t - G s)
